newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman ups stake in Ryoden Development.
newsitem.headline: Chairman ups stake in Ryoden Development.

text.p: Ryoden Development Ltd said on Friday its major Designcase Ltd, controlled by Ryoden chairman Hu Fa-kuang's family, lifted its direct interest in the company to 33.99 percent from 24.58 percent.
Designcase informed Ryoden that it exercised the option granted by Mitsubishi Electric Corp to buy 85 million Ryoden shares at HK$2.00 each, the company said in a statement.
Mitsubishi Electric's direct shareholdings in Ryoden fell to 2.36 percent from 11.77 percent after the sale, it said.
Other than the direct interest, Designcase holds 33.90 percent in Ryoden (Holdings) Ltd, it added.
Ryoden (Holdings) has a 28.74 percent direct interest in Ryoden Development, the company said.
Mitsubishi Electric is also a major shareholder of Ryoden (Holdings), owning 50 percent in the company, it added.
